description:
Research position overview

This Radboud project studies curiosity and learning among children aged ten to twelve in classroom settings. Research combines experiments, school-based studies and computational modelling, with close communication with Dutch-speaking children, parents and teachers.

Research Areas

  • Educational science
  • Psychology
  • Computational modelling

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionSalaried PhD position
Stipend / salaryEUR 3,204–4,051 gross/month
Duration1.5-year initial contract; 2.5-year extension after positive evaluation

Good Dutch and English are required for communication with schools and families. Salary increases through the doctoral salary scale.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationRelevant research master’s or master’s in education, psychology, cognitive science, neuroscience, AI or a related field.
LanguageGood Dutch and English required
Further conditionsRelevant MSc; good Dutch and English required; four-year position subject to evaluation.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round20 October 2026
LocationNetherlands

About Radboud University

Radboud offers doctoral and postdoctoral research through its faculties and institutes in Nijmegen. Advertised research positions set out the scientific project, qualifications, employment terms and application route.
